day_shape: 57 items: Trump announces release of US citizen held by Iran since Dec 2024, Treasury sanctions seven over weapons procurement, IRIB claims US struck Ahvaz hospital and Qeshm village, IDF strikes Gaza and southern Lebanon, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: US-Iran conflict escalation claims
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press said US strikes hit Baghiyatallah Hospital in Ahvaz and a village on Qeshm island, with Iran's Foreign Ministry alleging a US naval blockade and war crimes. Defa Press also announced IRGC Aerospace 'Operation Nasr 2' waves eight to ten against US positions.

threads.label: US detainee release and Treasury sanctions
threads.summary: Trump announced the release of a US citizen held by Iran since December 2024, per Jerusalem Post. The US Treasury sanctioned seven people involved in obtaining and distributing weapons to Iran in violation of UN restrictions.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea threats
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran asked the Houthis to be ready to close the Red Sea oil route if the US strikes Iranian power infrastructure. IRIB claimed India has banned its ships from transiting the Strait of Hormuz until further notice.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it destroyed four Hamas weapons depots in central Gaza overnight and killed Hamas battalion sniper commander Omar Ahmed Abu Qasem. Israeli drone and air strikes hit Nabatieh al-Fauqa and Zawtar al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, with IDF forces reporting a body tied to a stretcher in the buffer zone.

threads.label: Iranian domestic pressure and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported a leaked presidency document recording record public anger with nine in ten Iranians wanting change, and nearly 100,000 signing a petition urging Paydari Front hardliners to visit the southern war zone. Further reporting cited pensioners unable to cover basic costs and families abandoning daycare for grandparent care.

events.title_en: Baghiyatallah: America's attack on Martyr Baghiyatallah Hospital in Ahvaz is an example of war crime
events.summary_en: Baghiyatallah: America's attack on Martyr Baghiyatallah Hospital in Ahvaz is an example of war crime. The Foreign Ministry spokesperson, in a message condemning America's attack on Martyr Baghiyatallah Hospital in Ahvaz, said: Those who constantly speak of human rights but deliberately overlook hospitals and medical centres being targeted have lost all moral credibility. This brutal attack, reminiscent of Israeli crimes against medical centres, inflicted severe pain and distress on hospitalised children and resulted in 211 patients undergoing chemotherapy being evacuated as an emergency. This action is a cowardly crime and an example of war crimes against the most innocent people.

events.title: Four Hamas weapon depots were destroyed in Israeli strikes in the central Gaza Strip overnight, the IDF announces. The facilities had been used by Hamas to store assault rifles, RPGs, grenades, explosive devices, and other military equipment, according to the military. The IDF says the weapons were intended to be used by Hamas in attacks on troops stationed in the Strip, and they were destroyed to "remove the threat."
